Based on multiple leaks about the three colour options for the iPhone 18 Pro at its launch next week, there is currently a clear consensus on two of the colours.

However, two well-known leakers disagree on whether the third colour will be silver or black…

So far, every leak agrees on two of the expected colours, but there is still some degree of disagreement on the exact shade of the purple:

  • Deep cherry / wine red
  • Sky blue

But for the third colour — whether silver or black — there have been contradictory reports, with two authoritative leakers each sticking to their own view in this debate.

Black…

Just yesterday, Fixed Focus Digital said the third colour would be black, and that silver is "very likely" not to appear in this lineup. Those who favour silver can take some comfort, because Sky Blue will very likely come in the same extremely pale tone used on the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, looking closer to silver in most lighting conditions.

If true, this would delight many people, as quite a few were disappointed that the iPhone 17 Pro lacked a black or space grey option.

…or silver

However, although Sonny Dickson did not directly push back on that claim, he responded by posting a photo purporting to show SIM card trays in the three colours, with the third being silver. He had previously shared images that included a black version, but now says he has not seen that colour resurface in recent months.

Which one are you hoping for?

Which side are you hoping is right? Have your say in the poll, and share your thoughts in the comments.
